description: Slide decks over MCP: read and write decks as code, run Lorem's full AI pipeline, export PPTX/PDF.
name: io.github.AnkitaShanbhag30/lorem

environmentVariables.description: Base URL of the Lorem server the MCP talks to (default: the hosted service at https://lorem.fly.dev; set for self-hosted servers)
environmentVariables.name: LOREM_URL

environmentVariables.description: API key minted at https://lorem.fly.dev under Settings → API keys. Optional: without it the hosted server grants the same free guest trial as the website, then asks you to sign up
environmentVariables.name: LOREM_API_KEY
